items.summary: The official @cockroachjantaparty Instagram account (~25M followers) posted at ~10:43 AM PDT / 11:13 PM IST claiming Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das (@seven_shots_) and Ajinkya Shinde (@ajinkyashinde_cjp) plus other CJP members have been "illegally kidnapped" for 14+ hours, calling Delhi Police "puppets of the government." The photo itself — four civilians posing with a uniformed policeman inside the Jaffarpur Kalan PS office (wall plaque "ROLL OF INSPECTOR INVESTIGATION P.S. JAFFARPUR KALAN" visible) — is the first image from inside the detention station, posted while lawyer access to the detainees remains unresolved. ~19K likes within minutes of posting.
items.title: Official CJP handle: Ranka, Das, Shinde 'illegally kidnapped' for 14+ hours; photo from inside Jaffarpur Kalan police station
